skills.name: Quick review
skills.prompt: Review {url} briefly: only bugs and security issues. Do not edit files.

address_skills.name: Address review
address_skills.prompt: Help me address the review feedback on my pull request {url}. Use gh to read every unresolved review thread and review comment. For each one: quote it, propose the exact code change as a diff, and draft a short reply I can post. Do not edit files, commit, push, or post anything to GitHub.
